correctness.rationale: Exact join recurrence, absolutely convergent telescoping, all-prefix frequency existence, and preserved two-copy repetitions of a radius-two coded word proved for all n. The full stammering criterion hypotheses are checked with fixed exponent 3/2 and blocks of length 2^{n-1}+1, and rationality is excluded by recurrent 011 and unbounded 1-runs. Executed finite verifier independently checks 18 stage transitions and 11 code repetitions; no finite evidence is used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact 010-cylinder identity and arithmetic conclusion with Shallit’s full theorem, two publicly published Brik frequency/entropy results, and semantic searches on local binary coding, transcendence, aliases and broader results. Prior results prove single-letter transcendence, all-cylinder existence, or entropy bounds, but do not assert or imply arithmetic transcendence of the distinct 010 cylinder. The identical motif across a new sliding code is not a statement covered by their hypotheses without the new recurrence and nonperiodicity argument.

value.rationale: Contiguous 010 is the first short-factor probability genuinely independent of single-letter density on the golden-mean shift, making its exact arithmetic nature a motivated and nontrivial invariant. The result adds a transcendental three-point correlation using a new local-code identity, rather than a routine known one-letter frequency re-evaluation. The claim is specific and does not assert algebraic independence or unknown general classes. Explicit stationary periodic comparisons 110 versus 010111 verify that equal one-letter frequency does not determine the 010 cylinder.
